name: Risk Tolerance 1
definition: Risk tolerance of an investor for which a financial instrument is targeted.

RiskTolerancePRIIPSMethodology.name: Risk Tolerance PRIIPS Methodology
RiskTolerancePRIIPSMethodology.definition: Specifies the Summary Risk Indicator (SRI). When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 04010.

RiskToleranceUCITSMethodology.name: Risk Tolerance UCITS Methodology
RiskToleranceUCITSMethodology.definition: Specifies the Synthetic Risk and Reward Indicator (SRRI). When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 04020.

RiskToleranceInternal.name: Risk Tolerance Internal
RiskToleranceInternal.definition: Specifies the risk tolerance for non-PRIIPs and non-UCITS instructions. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 04030.

RiskToleranceForNonPRIIPSAndNonUCITSSpai.name: Risk Tolerance For Non PRIIPS And Non UCITS Spain
RiskToleranceForNonPRIIPSAndNonUCITSSpai.definition: Specifies the Summary Risk Indicator (SRI) for a Spanish product. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 04040.

NotForInvestorsWithTheLowestRiskToleranc.name: Not For Investors With The Lowest Risk Tolerance Germany
NotForInvestorsWithTheLowestRiskToleranc.definition: Specifies the risk tolerance for a German product. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 04050.

Other.name: Other
Other.definition: Specifies another type of risk tolerance.
